name: intro
title: Introducing rexenv
about: The ~65 s launch video: why rexenv exists (no Docker, any framework, any OS), then what sets it apart — importing from Local/Valet/Herd in place, WordPress without wp-admin, Git-native sites, AI agents with guardrails, safe defaults, every PHP/server/database. 1920×1080.

name: intro-vertical
title: Introducing rexenv — vertical
about: The same video, same voice, laid out 1080×1920 for Shorts / Reels / TikTok.

name: tour
title: The rexenv tour
about: Every feature in ~3 minutes, one beat each: install, new sites (WordPress, Laravel, PHP, Git, linked folder), import, blueprints, the WordPress manager, multisite, Git plugins, debugging, PHP, web servers, databases, domains, stopping a site, mail, sharing, the rex CLI, AI agents, the menu bar and updates.

name: install
title: Install rexenv
about: The one-command install in Terminal, then the four-step first run: components, domains & SSL, done.

name: wp-install
title: One-click WordPress
about: New site → WordPress → name it → Install; the provision card streams the real phases.

name: import
title: Import from Local, Valet & Herd
about: The Sites banner → the read-only scan → taking over Valet's .test → importing three sites with their databases.

name: mail
title: Mail catching
about: Mail grouped by site; a WordPress password reset arrives; text and HTML previews; Mark all read.

name: share
title: Share a site
about: A Cloudflare quick tunnel: Starting → Live, the admin/admin warning, Copy, Stop.

name: php
title: Multiple PHP versions
about: Switch a site to PHP 7.4 (confirm, EOL note), raise 8.3's limits, apply a patch update.

name: database
title: Databases
about: Four engines on their own ports, a version switch, the Database Browser, export and import a dump.

name: wp-manager
title: WordPress manager
about: Search and install WooCommerce, update Yoast, themes, users, Magic Login.

name: git-site
title: A site from Git
about: New site → Laravel → From Git: Fetch, pick a branch, and the job clones, wires .env, runs composer, artisan migrate and the asset build — log live.

name: link-folder
title: Serve an existing folder
about: Existing folder → detected Laravel serving public/ → Link site → the external tag. Nothing copied or moved.

name: multisite
title: WordPress multisite
about: Convert a site to a subdomain network from WordPress → Network, add a sub-site, manage the network; the New site toggle.

name: debugging
title: Debugging
about: Xdebug for one site, WP_DEBUG from Tools, the live debug.log in Logs, and the Terminal tab with the site's PHP and WP-CLI.

name: rex-cli
title: The rex command line
about: Install rex from Settings, then status, site list, site create, PHP switch, db export and doctor — and the app showing the result.

name: mcp-agent
title: AI agents (MCP)
about: Turn on the MCP endpoint, the connect command, an agent's calls in the feed (a scratch site, a refused change), the Agent access dial, Agent scratch sites.

name: repo-panel
title: Plugins & themes from Git
about: From Git → Fetch → Add plugin → clone + detect → one click per dependency step → Activate → the git badge → Pull.

name: domains
title: Domains
about: The default ending for new sites (.local refused, .test saved) and an extra name on a site — certificate re-issued.

name: site-stop
title: Stop one site
about: Stop site → “Stopped by you” → the Stopped filter → Start site. Shared services keep running.

name: servers
title: Web servers & Redis
about: Switch a site to FrankenPHP (embedded PHP 8.5), Apache for .htaccess, and Redis from Services on :16379.

name: blueprints
title: Blueprints
about: Save a WordPress setup in Settings; start a new site from it — the “applying blueprint” phase installs WooCommerce + Storefront.

name: self-update
title: Updates
about: The Settings badge → About → the consent sentence → Install → the restart question. (0.8.11 is a demo offer.)

name: new-sites
title: Laravel & plain PHP
about: A fresh Laravel app (installer, MySQL .env, migrations) and a Blank PHP site with its seeded starter database.

name: tray
title: The menu-bar app
about: Close the window — nothing stops; the tray menu (drawn from core/tray.rs); Open rexenv; Start at login.
